title: A Blue Whale's Tongue Weighs as Much as an Elephant

scenes.text: A blue whale's tongue can weigh as much as an elephant.
Guinness World Records lists it as the heaviest tongue of any animal.
It weighs about four tonnes, which is more than eight thousand pounds.
That is one muscle, inside one mouth.
And the animal it belongs to is the biggest ever known.
Picture an elephant lying inside a whale's mouth.

description:
A blue whale's tongue weighs about four tonnes, about as much as an elephant, and Guinness lists it as the heaviest tongue of any animal.
The blue whale itself is the largest animal known.
Which is bigger in your mind, an elephant or a whale tongue? Comment below.
